description: This file defines a React-like component using Lightning.js framework. It represents an 'Empty State' UI component for when no notes are present, with a method to create the first note, a template defining its visual structure, and computed properties for theme styling.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A Lightning.js component that displays a message indicating no notes are present and provides a button to create the first note.

methods.name: createFirst
methods.description: Adds a new note with empty title and content to the store.
